tests.procedure: Under strong white light check each received container separately in a clean transparent watch glass for foreign particles, colour and conformity with the visual specification.
tests.source: Vitmain D3 40 MIU__STM Crystalline Vitamin D3.txt:28

tests.procedure: Weigh 100 mg in a stoppered tube; add 0.1 mL solvent, shake 1 min, hold at 25.0 ± 0.5 °C for 15 min, repeat shake/hold once if not dissolved; add 0.9 mL, then 2 mL, then 7 mL solvent with the same shake and hold steps to classify very soluble / freely soluble / soluble / sparingly soluble; if still undissolved use 10 mg in 10 mL (slightly soluble), then 1 mg in 10 mL (very slightly soluble), else practically insoluble. Repeat with alcohol and chloroform.
tests.source: Vitmain D3 40 MIU__STM Crystalline Vitamin D3.txt:29

tests.procedure: IR identification: mix the sample intimately with potassium bromide and compress into a transparent pellet (wavelength range 2-12 µm); compare the spectrum with that of Crystalline Vitamin D3 RS.
tests.source: Vitmain D3 40 MIU__STM Crystalline Vitamin D3.txt:30

tests.procedure: UV identification: sample solution 10 µg/mL in alcohol; alcohol as blank; analytical wavelength 265 nm on calibrated UV spectrophotometer; record and compare the spectra of sample and standard solutions, calculate the absorptivities and compare them.

details.criterion: absorptivities do not differ by more than 3.0%

tests.procedure: Assay (USP, HPLC, main method): mobile phase n-amyl alcohol in hexane (3 in 1000). System suitability solution: 250 mg USP Vitamin D Assay System Suitability RS in 10 mL of toluene and mobile phase (1:1), heated under reflux at 90 °C for 45 min and cooled. Standard: 0.6 mg/mL USP Cholecalciferol RS in toluene, then 120 µg/mL in mobile phase. Sample: 0.6 mg/mL cholecalciferol in toluene, then 120 µg/mL in mobile phase. LC, UV 254 nm, column 4.6 x 250 mm packing L3, flow 1.5 mL/min, injection 5-10 µL. Suitability: resolution NLT 1.0 between trans-cholecalciferol and precholecalciferol; RSD NMT 2.0% for the cholecalciferol peak response. Result = (rU/rS) x (CS/CU) x 100.
